items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I'll tell you the band that had the real readers in it, P-Rong, A.J. P-Rong.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember that piece. Well now who were the bands that played mostly society music, just reading, no Dixieland?

Well Tuxedo, very little reading they had though, I ain't going to lie. I'll tell you the band that had the real readers in it, P-Rong, A.J. P-Rong. Did they play any Dixieland? They played Dixieland but they played a lot of the music, beautiful numbers and things you know? Yeah. Yeah.
And what about Celestan's Tuxedo? What would he feature?
